name: Nilrebmah V
description: Nilrebmah V was a terrestrial world planet in the Nilrebmah system. Covered in seas filled with fish and crustaceans, the planet's atmosphere was oxygen-rich and breathable by the majority of species; though the planet never evolved sentient life.
